articles.title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court
articles.snippet: The legal battle to head off the crypto transaction tax in Illinois has drawn up a hefty roster of industry opposition, and they're saying the tax won't work.

articles.title: Ethereum researchers drop faster blocks to race toward quantum defenses in 2027
articles.snippet: Ethlabs wants quantum-resistant accounts targeted for next year, even if wallet holders still have to switch signing methods themselves.

articles.title: Polymarket trims workforce under investor pressure as Kalshi surges ahead
articles.snippet: More than half of those affected were contractors, a source told Reuters. The cuts follow investor pressure on founder Shayne Coplan.

articles.title: Nomura weighs Laser Digital sale as European losses hit four straight quarters
articles.snippet: The Japanese brokerage has held talks with potential buyers, including Marex, as its European business posts more losses.

articles.title: Gemini sells UK and European operations to stablecoin payments firm KAST for under $10 million
articles.snippet: The sale follows the Winklevoss-founded crypto exchange’s retreat from several overseas markets as it restructures its business.
